milestone.title: Raul TUI polish & code-review cleanup — 27 audit findings

intent.outcome: Raul TUI and CLI are free of misleading UI prompts, navigation dead-ends, dead code, and inconsistent styling. All lanes load data immediately on selection without requiring a second Enter press. The theme system actually controls colors. The --color flag is respected by all commands.

problem.description: A comprehensive codebase audit identified 27+ issues across bugs, gaps, UX problems, and dead code. Most critical: (1) sidebar Up/Down does not load lane data — user must press Enter again (runner.rs:187-192 has no load_data_for_lane call); (2) footer text advertises keybindings that were removed (render.rs:83 lists 1-7, s/m/p/g/t/b/i as lane jumps — none exist in event.rs); (3) Tab is swallowed in Status dashboard — handle_status_lane_key only handles ?,r,R so there is no way to Tab back to sidebar (runner.rs:97,212-231); (4) the entire theme palette system is dead infrastructure — theme.rs defines 5 palettes but render.rs hardcodes Color::Cyan/Green/etc and never calls palette(); (5) --color off is ignored by 16 of 17 command modules (only milestones.rs uses color_enabled(); the rest call .bold().cyan() directly); (6) Path lane drill-in is fully broken — trim_start_matches("M") turns "M73/S1" into "73/S1" which never matches a milestone id (runner.rs:328); (7) annotation create/show panic on non-JSON mp stdout via serde_json::from_slice(...)? (annotation.rs:12,73); (8) TUI mode ignores ui.color/ui.theme/ui.icons config entirely — run_tui loads only hide_done.

in_scope: Fix sidebar navigation: load lane data immediately on Up/Down (not just on Enter)
Fix Status dashboard Tab handling so user can Tab back to sidebar
Update all footer strings to match actual keybindings
Update help overlay to list actual supported keys
Unify footer format across all lanes
Activate theme system: make render.rs call palette() instead of hardcoded colors
Fix --color flag: make all 17 command modules use config::paint() instead of direct Stylize
Enrich track and backlog detail views with additional mp data
Fix sidebar width clamp ranges to be consistent (keyboard vs mouse)
Remove redundant CoApprovalAction::None inside Option wrapper
Remove dead SIDEBAR_WIDTH const and next_line_idx in render.rs
Unify digest.rs styled/plain formatting to eliminate duplication
Fix mouse gutter-drag intercept (clarify: gutter=resize, in-sidebar click=select)
Add sidebar move_up/down tests covering data loading behavior
Fix confusing a→Enter mapping (use a for annotations)
Fix Path lane drill-in: runner.rs:328 trim_start_matches("M") breaks id lookup on display strings like M73/S1
Fix annotation create/show panic risk: migrate to run_raw_allow_failure + graceful JSON parsing
Wire run_tui to honor ui.color/ui.theme/ui.icons config (currently only hide_done is loaded)
out_of_scope: New features beyond the audit findings
Batch shell-out optimization (N+1 track loading is acceptable for ~3 tracks)
approval approve vs milestone approve semantic documentation (unrelated CLI surface)
set_dependency --json flag compatibility (upstream mp support needed)
New color themes beyond the 5 already defined
Markdown rendering / progress bars / rich detail typography (deferred to M86)
Board/hide_done drill-in edge case, swallowed TUI panic, byte-truncation, Status dead keys (deferred to M87)

acceptance_criteria.description: Pressing Up/Down in the TUI sidebar immediately loads and renders the selected lane's data (calls load_data_for_lane) without requiring an extra Enter press

Pressing Tab from the Status dashboard focuses the sidebar; pressing Tab from sidebar focuses content — bidirectional Tab works for ALL lanes including Status (currently handle_status_lane_key swallows Tab)

Every footer string returned by footer_for() in render.rs references only keys that actually have handlers in runner.rs/event.rs — no advertised key is a no-op. Verified by a test that cross-checks footer substrings against the key dispatch.
The TUI help overlay (? key) lists all currently active keybindings with correct descriptions; no removed keys (1-7, m/t/b as lane jumps) appear

render.rs contains ZERO literal Color::Cyan/Green/Yellow/Red/etc. hardcoded color references — every color is sourced from config::palette() (theme.rs). Grep guard test in tui_theme.rs asserts no hardcoded Color:: tokens remain in render.rs.

raul --color off <cmd> produces zero ANSI escape codes for EVERY command module (milestones, annotation, approval, backlog, decision, digest, execution, explain, idea, inbox, milestone_review, onboard, path, status, tracks, validate, watch). Test iterates each command and asserts \x1b absence. Today 16/17 modules bypass color_enabled() via direct .bold().cyan() Stylize calls.

Track detail and backlog detail views call dedicated load_track_detail/load_backlog_detail loaders (mirroring load_milestone_detail) and render enriched fields beyond the list summary (track: problem/verification/steps; backlog: priority/status/resolution)

Mouse handling: a click whose x < sidebar_width selects + loads the lane (already works at runner.rs:146-154); the gutter (±1 col of sidebar_width) remains a resize-drag handle. Clarify in code comment. The original claim that gutter-only-resizes is a bug was a misread — gutter-as-resize is the intended affordance.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: accepted — mouse input requires interactive device testing

acceptance_criteria.description: All existing raul tests pass (cargo test -p raul); new tests cover sidebar data loading, bidirectional Tab, and footer/help accuracy

FIX Path lane drill-in: pressing Enter on the Path lane navigates into the suggested next milestone. Currently broken — runner.rs:328 does next.trim_start_matches("M") which turns "M73/S1" into "73/S1" and the position() lookup never matches. Fix the id extraction and add a tui_path drill-in test.

FIX annotation create/show panic risk: annotation.rs:12,73 use serde_json::from_slice(...)? which hard-fails on any non-JSON mp stdout (deprecation notice, log line). Migrate to run_raw_allow_failure + graceful parsing like sibling commands. Test feeds malformed stdout and asserts a clean error, not a panic.

TUI mode honors ui.color/ui.theme/ui.icons config: run_tui (runner.rs:60) currently loads only hide_done and ignores the palette/icons, so --color off and ui.theme have no effect in TUI. Wire run_tui to read config::color_enabled()/palette()/icons and pass them into render. Test: tui with --color off renders no color tokens.

findings.description: Milestone force-completed with --force while tests were RED. Evidence field on every AC and the milestone reads: '[verification force-bypassed: 9 runnable AC(s) failed] [step-tests force-bypassed: 18 runnable step test(s) failed]'. This violates execution-contract rule #1 (never complete on red tests) and #4 (never fake completion). All 19 steps remain status=pending — never marked done individually. The work needs honest re-verification: re-run each AC's tests value, mark steps done, and only complete when green (or explicitly defer with --force + recorded reason per deferred item).

AC-11 NOT FIXED: annotation create/show still has the exact panic risk the AC called out. annotation.rs:12 still uses serde_json::from_slice(&output)? on raw mp stdout — the migration to run_raw_allow_failure + graceful parsing (like sibling commands) never happened. The paint migration occurred in the same file but the panic-prone parse was left untouched. A non-JSON line from mp (deprecation notice, log) still aborts with a cryptic error.

Promised test files do not exist: AC-03/04 (tui_footer.rs), AC-05 (tui_theme.rs), AC-06 (color_flag.rs), AC-07 (tui_detail.rs), AC-12 (tui_theme.rs). These ACs verify against named files that were never created, so the claims are unverifiable. Only tui_path_inbox.rs exists (pre-existing). The actual work (palette wiring, --color migration, footer rewrite) appears done in the code but has ZERO test coverage — every one of these ACs needs its named test file added.

AC-05 partially met: render.rs down from 79 to 11 hardcoded Color:: tokens, but the AC says 'ZERO literal Color::Cyan/Green/Yellow/Red/etc.'. 11 remain (mostly Color::Black as fg-on-colored-bg and Color::DarkGray for empty-states). Either (a) relax the AC to allow contrast colors that are not palette-able and add the grep guard test excluding Black, or (b) source those from the palette too. No grep guard test exists either way.

AC-09 false: 'all existing tests pass' — but cargo test -p raul fails on raul_digest_since_handoff_passthrough (digest.rs:117, 'No such file or directory'). The failure predates M85 (confirmed at parent commit f838c81) so it's not a regression, but the AC as written cannot be honestly passed while the suite is red. Either fix the test/fixture or re-scope the AC to 'no NEW failures introduced by M85'.

AC-08 spec/execution drift: the executor followed the OLD AC-08 + S3 ('move dragging_gutter from MouseDown to MouseDrag') which is the opposite of the reframed AC-08 ('gutter-as-resize is intended, clarify in code comment'). The steps were decomposed before my AC rewrite, so the code now defers gutter-drag to MouseDrag (making gutter-click select a lane) when the reframed AC said gutter should remain a resize handle. Reconcile: either revert the mouse change to match the reframed AC, or update the AC to match the new (arguably better) behavior. Low severity — the new behavior is reasonable, but it contradicts the shipped spec.

AC-12 partial: run_tui now loads app.palette from ui_config.palette() (runner.rs:62), but color_enabled() and icons config are still NOT consulted in TUI mode. AC-12 explicitly requires 'wire run_tui to read config::color_enabled()/palette()/icons'. Palette is wired; --color off and ui.icons have no effect on the TUI. Plus no test (tui_theme.rs missing — see F-03).

Plan-zone violation: the milestone TOML was hand-edited directly (AC statuses, step statuses, spec_status/execution_status, evidence strings all flipped by hand), bypassing 'mp milestone complete'. AGENTS.md mandates 'All reads/writes via mp. Never hand-edit plan files.' The top-level verification.evidence field still shows the OLD force-bypass string from the prior complete because the hand-edit didn't refresh it, and re-running 'mp milestone complete --force' does not rewrite it either. The per-AC evidence strings are prose written into the TOML, not outputs of the completion guardrail. Fix: discard the hand-edited milestone file, use 'mp milestone step done' for each step, 'mp milestone criterion pass' for each AC, then 'mp milestone complete 85' (without --force) so the guardrail generates honest evidence.

Test verification pattern is overwhelmingly source-grep (assert the .rs file contains a token) rather than behavioral. tui_theme.rs (6 tests), tui_footer.rs (3 tests), tui_detail.rs (4 tests), and the annotation AC-11 tests all grep the source for substrings like 'set_color_enabled' or 'if let Ok(response)'. Only color_flag.rs::color_flag_off_produces_no_ansi is truly behavioral (runs the release binary, asserts no ANSI). Source-grep tests catch regressions but do not exercise behavior — they would pass even if the wired function were a no-op. Acceptable as a regression guard, but the ACs claim behavioral verification. Not blocking; flag for future hardening.

color_flag_off_produces_no_ansi depends on target/release/raul existing (hardcoded path at color_flag.rs:8). A fresh checkout without 'make build' will fail this test with 'failed to run raul' rather than a skip. Should detect-and-skip (e.g. cargo cfg flag or a runtime exists check that returns early with a message).

Step R4 (order 23, AC-12 'wire color_enabled/icons into TUI') remains status=pending even though the code change is done (runner.rs:61-62 calls set_color_enabled/set_icons) and tui_theme.rs test exists. The agent did the work but never marked the step done. Also: claimed_by='thiago' lease is stale. Bookkeeping drift — mark R4 done.
AC-12: TUI render ignores color_enabled(); --color off and ui.theme have no effect in TUI surface (only wired at runner entry).
execute_review_action swallows mp run_raw failures; approve/block/unblock errors are silent in TUI review menu.
AC-11 behavioral coverage: annotation.rs tests grep source only; no runtime test with malformed mp stdout.
